auditor_claire: Hi all — auditor requested a compact evidence package for the 2024-09-12 inference incident. They want: all KMS envelope key ops in the 4h window, raw CloudTrail event JSONs, requestId -> envelopeKey mapping, and RBAC snapshots for involved service accounts. Also a short note on retention and whether rotations were delayed.

sasha: can do. plan: (a) export KMS GenerateDataKey/Decrypt + DescribeKey admin events from CloudTrail, (b) pull SIEM raw events for correlation, (c) snapshot RoleBindings and IAM policies, (d) produce manifest + checksums.

andre: tip — include both ciphertextBlob and responseElements.keyId in the export. in our logs the ciphertextBlob identifies the envelope ciphertext and keyId gives the CMK used. sample splunk query I run:
```
index=aws_kms eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt | fields _time, requestID, requestParameters.ciphertextBlob, responseElements.keyId, userIdentity.arn
```

maria: i'll grab git history for k8s/rbac and the gitops commits touching service-accounts. commands I'm using:
```
git log --pretty=oneline --since="2024-09-11" --until="2024-09-13" -- k8s/rbac || true
kubectl get rolebinding --all-namespaces -o yaml > /tmp/rolebindings-20240912.yaml
```

auditor_claire: we need a short reconciler doc that ties requestID -> envelopeKeyID -> serviceAccount (principal), plus timestamps. raw JSONs ok. please flag any gaps where requestIDs are missing from CloudTrail.

sasha: noted. question: do we export the full CloudTrail event or redact any IP/userAgent? auditors asked for raw JSON but we should check PII. my take: deliver raw CloudTrail + KMS event JSONs to evidence bucket, then provide a redacted copy for broader distribution.

andre: for Vault-managed secrets, include Vault audit entries showing token create/renew/revoke around the window. that helps tie service-account credential lifecycle to KMS ops. use:
```
vault audit list
vault read sys/audit/some-audit-backend/lookup -- -start=2024-09-12T02:00:00Z -end=2024-09-12T06:00:00Z
```

oncall_bot: Incident INC-4312: Evidence collection task assigned to @sasha. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/forensics-collection.

evidence-bot: Created evidence container: s3://redwood-evidence/INC-4312/20240912-kms-raw.tar.gz (sha256: a1f9...ef0). Manifest at s3://redwood-evidence/INC-4312/manifest-20240912.json

sasha: packaging deliverables: raw_cloudtrail_events.json (all matching events), kms_siem_export.json (raw), rolebindings_snapshot.yaml, gitops_commit_range.txt, vault_audit_extract.json, reconciliation.csv (requestId,envelopeKeyId,principal,timestamp). will add a short README explaining retention and sampling. ETA 6h.

auditor_claire: please include our control mapping note: which control IDs these artifacts map to (SOC2 CC6.1: access logging, CC7.2: change control, ISO 27001 A.10 key management etc.). a one-paragraph mapping per control is fine.

maria: adding control map section to README. retention note: CloudTrail retention: 90 days in primary account, aggregated SIEM holds 1 year, evidence bucket archived per retention.policy=indefinite (legal holds possible). will cite internal policies.

andre: verify whether any rotation jobs ran during the window. our gitops shows no rolebinding changes, but Vault scheduled key rotation job ran at 2024-09-12T03:45Z for service-account-token. i'll capture the Vault job run log and include next to the reconciler.

sasha: one more thing: auditor wants assurance that envelope keys were single-use per GenerateDataKey call. include a note about our usage pattern: we derive a unique data key per GenerateDataKey call and we do not persist ciphertextBlob aside from short-term caches. add code snippet to README showing usage of GenerateDataKey/Encrypt with nonce per request.

auditor_claire: good. last ask: include RBAC 'before' and 'after' snapshots with timestamps. if no changes, state that explicitly.

sasha: done, rolebindings_snapshot.yaml includes capture timestamp and gitops commit reference; no RBAC changes detected in the window. delivering package now to evidence bucket and sending presigned links to auditor mailbox. :email:

auditor_claire: thanks — that'll work. if you find any gaps (e.g., missing requestIDs or partial logs), call them out in the README.
